evals.prompt: Build me a little web dashboard that watches a folder of JSON log files and shows error rates per service, updating live. It's just for me, running on localhost.
evals.expected_output: Instrument map inferred with zero questions (internal, monitoring, personal). Taste Contract emitted before code. No-build stack: single HTML file or tiny server + SSE, vanilla JS, hand-rolled sparklines/SVG. Dark hue-biased ground, mono data face, tabular numerals, no ban-list items.

evals.prompt: I need a landing page for my side project — it's a note-taking app for fiction writers called Inkwell. Something that would make a writer actually want to try it.
evals.expected_output: Editorial (or Gallery) map inferred; at most one small question batch if any. Static single-file or Astro page. Serif display type, warm paper ground, accent derived from the project name, one signature move (e.g. drop cap or margin notes), a bespoke detail tied to writing/ink. No centered-hero-two-buttons-three-cards, no indigo gradient, no Inter.

evals.prompt: make a quick browser game where falling shapes stack up and you rotate them to fit, needs to feel juicy
evals.expected_output: Toybox or Arcade map inferred from 'game' + 'juicy', zero questions. Canvas2D loop with plain DOM overlay for chrome, no framework. Springy/snappy motion per map (squash-and-stretch or screen-shake), chunky display face, saturated committed palette, score treated as a visual anchor. No emoji icons.
